source: UPSC Mains GS Paper 2 (Polity) chapter list aligned to M. Laxmikanth, Indian Polity. Chapter names are a study checklist, not an endorsement of any edition.
note: Chapter-depth checklist. Each chapter names the lesson pages expected to carry it, the sub-topics that must appear, and a minimum prose depth. A chapter is 'stub' when its best-matching section is far below minWords, 'thin' when below it, 'missing' when no section or lesson is found. Depth is measured from the page's own section headings; sub-topics are keyword presence. Both are heuristics: a human must verify accuracy. GS1/GS3/GS4 chapters are derived from each lesson page's own h2 chapters (inventory audit at a 600-word floor); the polity map is a curated checklist.
